ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to MBA and graduate Architecture and Urban Planning students. Interested MAS students should contact their ACCY Advisor to add their names to the course request list. Graduate students from other programs should contact the Finance Department directly about the possibility of enrolling.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Finance or Civil Engineering or Urban Planning or Landscape Architecture or Architecture or Business Administration (MBA) major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
